# Obelisk Proof Assistant (MKTD1-system & MKTD2-system)

> Obelisk Proof Assistant is an interactive formal verification platform and proof assistant developed by Georgy Dunaev in portable Standard ML (SML'97 compatible with both CakeML and Poly/ML). It implements two co-existing formal systems grounded in Morse-Kelley (MK) and von Neumann-Bernays-Goedel (NBG) class theory with Dunaev Tagged Ordered Pairs and Grothendieck-Tarski universes:
> 1. **MKTD1-system / MKTD1-prover** (`MKTD1-framework` / `MKTD1-theory`): Sequent calculus and typed AST kernel (`Fm_Expre`, `Class_Expre`, `Stmt`, `Ctx`, `Theory`, `Prf`) with 118 machine-verified kernel entries (`1.1` through `5.21`), including the complete formalization that every Grothendieck-Tarski universe $U$ equals the von Neumann cumulative stage $V_{U \cap \mathrm{On}}$ (`ThmUniverseEqVonNeumannStageInterOn`, Entry `3.90`).
> 2. **MKTD2-system / MKTD2-prover** (`MKTD2-framework` / `MKTD2-theory`): Dependent propositions-as-types and proof-term system (`Π`, `Σ`, `λ`, dependent equality, set-theoretic & categorical libraries) with 225 mechanically type-checked records (202 derived theorems, 16 conservative definitions, 7 irreducible MK/NBG axioms).

Non-attacking AI agents, search indexers, and automated reasoning assistants are welcomed. For token-efficient, zero-HTML-noise ingestion, prefer the ML-generated Markdown (`.md`) and JSON (`.json`) endpoints listed below.

## Agent-First Markdown & JSON Endpoints (Zero HTML Noise)

- [MKTD1-system Complete Reference Manual (Markdown)](https://obeliskproofassistant.github.io/generated/manual.md): All 118 entries (`1.1` to `5.21`) of `MKTD1-system` / `MKTD1-theory` with Unicode formulas, LaTeX formulas, ANSII syntax, Schemes of Types, and formal verification notes.
- [MKTD1-system Variant 1 Catalog (Markdown)](https://obeliskproofassistant.github.io/generated/variant1.md): Direct Markdown mirror of the `MKTD1-system` sequent-calculus specification.
- [MKTD1-system Verified Proofs & Rules (Markdown)](https://obeliskproofassistant.github.io/generated/proofs.md): Filtered Markdown catalog containing only the Inference Rules and Machine-Verified Theorems of `MKTD1-system`.
- [MKTD2-system Library (Markdown)](https://obeliskproofassistant.github.io/generated/nbg_library.md): All 225 mechanically type-checked theorems, definitions, and axioms of `MKTD2-system` / `MKTD2-theory` with Unicode/LaTeX statements and proof terms.
- [MKTD2-system Variant 2 Catalog (Markdown)](https://obeliskproofassistant.github.io/generated/variant2.md): Direct Markdown mirror of the `MKTD2-system` formulas-as-types library.
- [MKTD1-system Structured JSON Database](https://obeliskproofassistant.github.io/generated/theory_db.json): Machine-readable JSON export of all 118 `MKTD1-system` entries, sections, ASTs, and proof constructors.
- [MKTD2-system Structured JSON Database](https://obeliskproofassistant.github.io/generated/nbg_library.json): Machine-readable JSON export of all 225 `MKTD2-system` records.
- [Comprehensive LLM Context Bundle (`llms-full.txt`)](https://obeliskproofassistant.github.io/llms-full.txt): Self-contained architectural guide, taxonomy specification, key theorems, and answer-engine FAQ for AI agents.

## Foundational Monograph & Documentation

- [Foundations of Mathematics and the Obelisk Proof Assistant (PDF, 424 pages)](https://obeliskproofassistant.github.io/foundations.pdf): Full book covering `MKTD1-framework`, `MKTD2-framework`, Dunaev Tagged Ordered Pairs, Kleene star tuple disjointness, decoupled semantic vs. syntactic completeness, and the proof that $U = V_{U \cap \mathrm{On}}$.
- [Terminology & Symbol Glossary (Markdown)](https://obeliskproofassistant.github.io/docs/glossary.md): Formal definitions of `Class`, `isSet(x)`, Dunaev Tagged Ordered Pairs `(A, B)_D`, contexts `Δ` and `Γ`, and hygiene predicates (`FV`, `IFV`, `FFI`).
- [Changelog (Markdown)](https://obeliskproofassistant.github.io/CHANGELOG.md): Version history of kernel rules, axioms, definitions, and verified theorems.

## Interactive HTML Portals

- [Obelisk Main Portal](https://obeliskproofassistant.github.io/): Split-screen documentation and interactive SML/JS WebREPL.
- [Obelisk AI & Architecture Overview](https://obeliskproofassistant.github.io/obelisk_ai.html): Executive technical specification, typing rules, and worked examples for `MKTD1-system` and `MKTD2-system`.
- [Interactive WebREPL](https://obeliskproofassistant.github.io/repl.html): Browser-based proof assistant console.
- [Author Homepage (Georgy Dunaev)](https://georgydunaev.github.io/): Academic profile, publications, and formal verification projects.
